questions.prompt: I invested ₩1 million and sold everything for ₩1 million. I ___.
questions.explanation: 원금만 회수했으므로 break even을 써요.

questions.prompt: I wish I'd bought those shares last year. If only I'd ___ them!
questions.explanation: 과거 후회는 If only I'd + 과거분사로 표현해요.

questions.prompt: Rather than putting everything into one company, she decided to ___ her investments.
questions.explanation: 여러 투자처로 분산하는 것은 diversify예요.

questions.prompt: Everyone was buying the coin, so I bought it too. I jumped on the ___.
questions.explanation: jump on the bandwagon은 유행에 편승하다라는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: I sold my shares in a panic when prices suddenly dropped. I ___.
questions.explanation: 공포에 휩쓸려 매도하는 행동이에요.

questions.prompt: I still haven't decided whether to invest. I'm ___ about it.
questions.explanation: on the fence는 결정을 내리지 못한 상태예요.

questions.prompt: I kept my shares instead of selling them. I ___ them.
questions.explanation: hold on to는 팔지 않고 계속 보유하다라는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: He invested all his available money in one stock. He ___.
questions.explanation: go all in은 가진 자금을 모두 거는 것을 뜻해요.

questions.prompt: She bought shares without thinking it through. It was an ___ decision.
questions.explanation: impulsive는 충동적인이라는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: He knew the risks and carefully weighed them before investing. He took ___.
questions.explanation: take calculated risks는 위험을 따져 보고 감수하는 것이에요.

questions.prompt: Her shoes are soaking wet. She ___ stepped in a puddle. (strong deduction)
questions.explanation: must have + 과거분사는 과거에 대한 강한 추측이에요.

questions.prompt: He was overseas that day. He ___ been at the party. (strong negative deduction)
questions.explanation: can't have + 과거분사는 ~했을 리 없다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: Perhaps she lost her keys. She might have ___ them.
questions.explanation: might have 뒤에는 과거분사가 와요.

questions.prompt: The delay caused us ___ our flight.
questions.explanation: cause + 사람 + to부정사 패턴이에요.

questions.prompt: A small disagreement became a huge fight. Things got ___.
questions.explanation: get out of hand는 통제하기 어려워지다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: I thought he was guilty, but I've changed my mind. ___, he may be innocent.
questions.explanation: 기존 생각을 바꿀 때 on second thought를 써요.

questions.prompt: ___, I remember seeing her at the station! (a newly remembered clue)
questions.explanation: 새롭게 떠오른 단서를 말할 때 쓰는 표현이에요.

questions.prompt: He says he was alone, but there are two cups on the table. His story ___.
questions.explanation: doesn't add up은 앞뒤가 맞지 않다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: Your explanation is possible, but I still don't believe it. I'm not ___.
questions.explanation: I'm not convinced는 아직 납득이 안 된다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: The road was closed, ___ explains why he was late.
questions.explanation: which explains why는 앞 상황이 이유를 설명할 때 써요.

challenges.title: The Story That Stuck With Me

questions.prompt: I couldn't put the novel down after the first chapter. I was ___ from the start.
questions.explanation: hooked는 푹 빠진 상태를 뜻해요.

questions.prompt: The film made me question my own beliefs. It was ___.
questions.explanation: thought-provoking은 생각할 거리를 준다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: My family went through the same experience, so the story hit close to ___.
questions.explanation: hit close to home은 자신의 상황과 비슷해서 와닿다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: The ending was completely unexpected. It caught me off ___.
questions.explanation: catch someone off guard는 예상하지 못한 상황에 놀라게 하다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: I recognized my own struggles in the heroine. I could relate ___ her.
questions.explanation: relate to + 대상 패턴이에요.

questions.prompt: The documentary showed me a problem I had never noticed. It opened my eyes ___ it.
questions.explanation: open someone's eyes to는 새롭게 알게 해 주다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: I watched the movie years ago, but it still ___ with me.
questions.explanation: stick with me는 오래 기억에 남다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: The film felt endless because the plot moved so slowly. It ___.
questions.explanation: drag on은 지루하게 길어지다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: I want to introduce the plot without revealing the ending. Without giving too much ___, it's a mystery.
questions.explanation: give away는 비밀이나 내용을 드러내다는 뜻이에요.

questions.prompt: The movie follows a woman who can travel through time. What does follows mean here?
questions.explanation: 이야기 소개에서 follow는 인물의 이야기를 따라가다는 뜻이에요.
